introduction: ERC-7572 standardizes a contractURI() function that returns a URI resolving to contract-level metadata, such as a contract's name, description, and image, so dapps and indexers can display it without per-application configuration. It was proposed by Devin Finzer, Alex Atallah, and Ryan Ghods in December 2023. The interface also defines a ContractURIUpdated event so indexers know when to refetch the metadata. Note: ERC-7572 is a Draft; the specification is still under active development and may change substantially.
designPurpose: ERC-7572 was designed to formalize a convention that dapps had used for years without a shared reference. Contracts commonly exposed a name or symbol only per-token or through ad-hoc functions, so each marketplace and explorer configured a contract's display information separately. By standardizing a single contractURI() call that returns a JSON document, and pairing it with a ContractURIUpdated event, the standard lets one metadata source drive every interface and keeps indexers synchronized when it changes.
commonUsage: contractURI() is used mainly by NFT collections and other token contracts that need a collection-level name, description, and imagery, which marketplaces and explorers render as a profile and banner for the contract. The returned string may point to an offchain resource or embed an onchain data:application/json JSON string. Its schema defines fields including name, symbol, description, image, banner_image, featured_image, external_link, and collaborators, of which only name is required.
fn.contractURI.desc: Returns a URI that resolves to a JSON document of contract-level metadata, such as the contract's name, description, and image. The URI may reference an offchain resource or embed an onchain data:application/json JSON string.
fn.contractURI.returns.uri: The URI pointing to the contract's metadata JSON document.
fn.ContractURIUpdated.desc: Emitted when the contract-level metadata changes, signaling offchain indexers to refetch the document returned by contractURI().
sim.readMetadataWalkthrough.name: Contract Metadata Resolution
sim.readMetadataWalkthrough.desc: Follow a dapp reading a contract's metadata through contractURI(), then an update that emits ContractURIUpdated to notify indexers.
sim.readMetadataWalkthrough.step.call: A dapp calls contractURI() on the contract to obtain the URI of its contract-level metadata.
sim.readMetadataWalkthrough.step.read: The contract reads its stored URI and returns a link, such as an ipfs:// address, that resolves to the metadata JSON document.
sim.readMetadataWalkthrough.step.update: When the owner updates the metadata, the contract emits ContractURIUpdated, prompting offchain indexers to refetch the document.
